The supplied pipeline requires an 11-quarter rolling history, outcomes through future quarter 12, and monthly FRED leads followed by quarterly leads. Exact panel/sample endpoints are not specified by the inputs currently available, so source-history sufficiency cannot be determined.

SAS library/data-file paths and Stata Code/Data roots still contain ellipsis placeholders. Resolve them in a portable working copy and align the supplied cross-language outputs and consumers before a future run.

Online appendix 3b consumes FV_clean_OA4.dta. The supplied 2c source includes the labeled OA4 filter and save as comments, so the branch is supported preparation: first run unchanged 2c to preserve baseline FV_clean_main.dta; then run an OA4-only working copy from the same original upstream inputs, activating the filter before winsorization and the OA4 save while disabling the baseline save only in that variant. evidence.description: Stata 2c imports the named FRED CSV and builds a future-lead quarterly deposit-growth measure.
evidence.file: Data_Package (JAR Submission)/2. Merge datasets and construct variables/2c. Merge aggregate deposit data and construct final variables.do
evidence.quote:
// Prepare aggregate deposit dataset downloaded from St. Louis Fed website. Calcualte economy-wide aggregate deposit growth. 
	import delimited ".../Data/DPSACBM027NBOG.csv", clear
	gen date2 = date(date, "MDY")
	format date2 %td
	gen qtr=qofd(date2)
	format qtr %tq
	gen year_month = mofd(date2)
	format year_month %tm

	tsset year_month
	gen aggdep = f.dpsacbm027nbog
	gen month = month(date2)
	keep if inlist(month, 3, 6, 9, 12)
	
	tsset qtr
	gen agg_dep_gr = (f2.aggdep - aggdep) / aggdep * 200
	keep qtr aggdep agg_dep_gr
	save aggdep, replace

// Prepare SOD dataset constructed in "1d. Process and construct SOD data.sas". Calculate weighted average aggregate deposit growth in a bank's states of operations.
	use ".../Bank_States_06032023.dta", clear
	rename YEAR year
	bys bankid year: egen all_state_dep = sum(state_dep)
	bys bankid year: egen bank_dep = sum(bk_state_dep)
	gen bk_state_share = bk_state_dep/bank_dep
	gen dep_gr_wt = dep_gr * bk_state_share
	bys bankid year: egen dep_gr_mean = sum(dep_gr_wt)
